  AND (r.ts >= 1522954374265000000 AND r.ts <= 1522955468388000000)

MATCH (source)-[r]->(destination)
WHERE (source.value = "firefox" OR source.value = "Cache I/O") 
  AND (r.ts >= 1522954374265000000 AND r.ts <= 1522955468388000000) 
OPTIONAL MATCH (source)-[r1]-(neighbor1)
OPTIONAL MATCH (destination)-[r2]-(neighbor2)
RETURN source, r, destination, r1, neighbor1, r2, neighbor2
